component.name: Balina
component.summary: Build, analyse and learn Bayesian networks and influence diagrams

description.p: BALINA (Bayesian And Logical Influence-diagram Network Application) combines a graphical editor with exact probabilistic inference (junction tree), decision analysis (maximum expected utility and optimal policies), parameter learning (Dirichlet priors, EM), structure learning (PC, Hill-Climbing, Tabu Search, MMHC), sensitivity analysis and stochastic simulation.
It reads and writes XMLBIF and GeNIe/SMILE files and CSV case data.
